# Taplink SDK for Android — AI Integration Reference

**Taplink SDK** is a semi-integrated payment SDK for Android POS applications provided by SUNBAY.
Latest public release target: **1.0.8**.
It supports three connection modes: App-to-App (Local), LAN (WLAN), and Cable (USB/Serial).

## Current Callback Semantics

- `onProgress(event)` keeps reporting transaction progress.
- `onSuccess(result)` is the only callback for terminal-confirmed outcomes: approved, declined, and processing.
- Use `result.isSuccess()`, `result.isFailed()`, and `result.isProcessing()` to branch.
- `onFailure(error)` is reserved for communication or technical errors only.
- `PaymentCallbackAdapter` only provides empty defaults; handle outcomes in `onSuccess`.
- `PaymentResult.toPaymentError()` is available for migrating legacy decline/error UIs.
- `CANCELLED` status and `isCancelled()` are removed; cancelled or aborted transactions arrive as `FAILED`.

---

## Module Structure

Only depend on `lib_taplink_sdk`. Never import from `lib_taplink_communication`.

```kotlin
// build.gradle.kts
dependencies {
    implementation(project(":lib_taplink_sdk"))
}
```

Main package: `com.sunmi.tapro.taplink.sdk`

---

## 3-Step Integration

### Step 1 — Initialize (Application.onCreate)

```kotlin
TaplinkSDK.init(this, TaplinkConfig(
    appId      = BuildConfig.TAPLINK_APP_ID,
    merchantId = BuildConfig.TAPLINK_MERCHANT_ID,
    secretKey  = BuildConfig.TAPLINK_SECRET_KEY,
    logEnabled = BuildConfig.DEBUG
))
```

### Step 2 — Connect (Activity/Service)

```kotlin
// onCreate: register persistent status listener
TaplinkSDK.setConnectionListener(object : ConnectionListener {
    override fun onConnected(deviceId: String, taproVersion: String) { /* enable UI */ }
    override fun onDisconnected(reason: String) { /* disable UI */ }
    override fun onError(error: ConnectionError) { /* show error */ }
})

// onResume: connect if not connected
if (!TaplinkSDK.isConnected()) {
    TaplinkSDK.connect(ConnectionConfig.createDefault(), oneTimeListener)
}

// onDestroy: cleanup
TaplinkSDK.removeConnectionListener()
TaplinkSDK.disconnect()
```

### Step 3 — Execute Transaction

```kotlin
val client = TaplinkSDK.getClient()

val request = SaleRequest.builder()
    .setReferenceOrderId("ORDER_${System.currentTimeMillis()}")
    .setTransactionRequestId("TXN_${System.currentTimeMillis()}")   // MUST be unique
    .setAmount(AmountInfo(BigDecimal("1000"), "USD"))         // 1000 cents = $10.00
    .setPaymentMethod(PaymentMethodInfo(PaymentCategory.CARD))
    .build()

client.sale(request, object : PaymentCallback {
    override fun onProgress(event: PaymentEvent) { /* update UI */ }
    override fun onSuccess(result: PaymentResult) {
        when {
            result.isSuccess()    -> confirmPayment(result)
            result.isProcessing() -> pollStatus(result.transactionRequestId!!)
            result.isFailed()     -> showError(result.message)
        }
    }
    override fun onFailure(error: PaymentError) { handleError(error) }
})
```

---

## Connection Modes

### App-to-App (same device)
```kotlin
val config = ConnectionConfig.createAppMode()
// or: ConnectionConfig().setConnectionMode(ConnectionMode.APP_TO_APP)
```

### LAN / WLAN
```kotlin
// First-time: specify IP + port (range 8443–8453)
val config = ConnectionConfig.createLanMode(host = "192.168.1.100", port = 8443)

// Subsequent: SDK uses cached device info
val config = ConnectionConfig.createLanMode()
```

### Cable (USB / Serial)
```kotlin
// AUTO tries: VSP → RS232 → AOA
val config = ConnectionConfig.createCableMode()
// or with specific protocol:
val config = ConnectionConfig.createCableMode(CableProtocol.USB_VSP)
```

### Auto-detect (no mode specified)
```kotlin
val config = ConnectionConfig.createDefault()  // tries APP_TO_APP → Cable → LAN
```

---

## LAN Address Acquisition (since v1.0.8)

Get the LAN terminal host/port automatically instead of typing it. These APIs RETURN the address via `DiscoveryListener` (they do NOT connect) — auto-fill your input fields, then connect with `ConnectionConfig.createLanMode(host, port)`.

```kotlin
// mDNS discovery (_taplink._tcp, 15s timeout) — no extra dependency needed
TaplinkSDK.discoverLanServices(object : DiscoveryListener {
    override fun onDiscovered(services: List<DiscoveredService>) {
        val t = services.firstOrNull() ?: return          // (name, host, port)
        connectLan(t.host, t.port)                          // your standard LAN connect
    }
    override fun onError(error: ConnectionError) { showError(error.message) }
})

// QR scan of a lan://host/port code (built-in camera; returns single-element list)
TaplinkSDK.scanLanQrCode(object : DiscoveryListener {
    override fun onDiscovered(services: List<DiscoveredService>) {
        val t = services.firstOrNull() ?: return
        connectLan(t.host, t.port)
    }
    override fun onError(error: ConnectionError) {
        when (error.code) {
            "E504" -> {}                                    // user cancel — silent
            "E505" -> showError("Camera permission denied")
            "E506" -> showError("No usable camera available on this device")
            else   -> showError(error.message)
        }
    }
})

// One-step variants that discover/scan AND connect (report via ConnectionListener):
TaplinkSDK.autoDiscoverAndConnect(connectionListener)
TaplinkSDK.scanAndConnect(connectionListener)
```

- `DiscoveredService(name: String, host: String, port: Int)`.
- QR scan requires the host app to add CameraX 1.3.4 (camera-core/camera2/lifecycle/view) + ZXing 3.5.3 — they are not transitive through the AAR. mDNS discovery needs no extra dependency.
- Error codes: `E501` no services, `E502` all failed, `E503` operation in progress, `E504` user cancel, `E505` camera permission denied, `E506` no usable camera.

---

## All Transaction Types

| Method | Class | When to use |
|--------|-------|-------------|
| `client.sale()` | `SaleRequest` | Standard payment |
| `client.refund()` | `RefundRequest` | Refund after sale |
| `client.void()` | `VoidRequest` | Cancel same-day transaction |
| `client.auth()` | `AuthRequest` | Pre-authorization (freeze funds) |
| `client.postAuth()` | `PostAuthRequest` | Complete a pre-auth |
| `client.incrementalAuth()` | `IncrementalAuthRequest` | Increase pre-auth amount |
| `client.tipAdjust()` | `TipAdjustRequest` | Adjust tip after sale |
| `client.abort()` | `AbortRequest` | Cancel in-progress transaction |
| `client.batchClose()` | `BatchCloseRequest` | End-of-day settlement |
| `client.query()` | `QueryRequest` | Query transaction status (runs in background, no Tapro UI shown — implement your own loading indicator) |

### Refund
```kotlin
// Referenced (with original txn ID)
val request = RefundRequest.referencedBuilder()
    .setTransactionRequestId("TXN_${System.currentTimeMillis()}")
    .setOriginalTransactionId("original_txn_id")
    .setAmount(AmountInfo(BigDecimal("500"), "USD"))
    .build()

// Non-referenced (card swipe required)
val request = RefundRequest.nonReferencedBuilder()
    .setTransactionRequestId("TXN_${System.currentTimeMillis()}")
    .setReferenceOrderId("REFUND_${System.currentTimeMillis()}")
    .setAmount(AmountInfo(BigDecimal("500"), "USD"))
    .build()
```

### Void
```kotlin
val request = VoidRequest.builder()
    .setTransactionRequestId("TXN_${System.currentTimeMillis()}")
    .setOriginalTransactionId("original_txn_id")
    .build()
```

### Pre-Authorization
```kotlin
val request = AuthRequest.builder()
    .setReferenceOrderId("AUTH_${System.currentTimeMillis()}")
    .setTransactionRequestId("TXN_${System.currentTimeMillis()}")
    .setAmount(AuthAmountInfo(authAmount = BigDecimal("5000"), pricingCurrency = "USD"))
    .build()

// Complete pre-auth
val request = PostAuthRequest.builder()
    .setTransactionRequestId("TXN_${System.currentTimeMillis()}")
    .setOriginalTransactionId("original_auth_txn_id")
    .setAmount(AmountInfo(BigDecimal("4500"), "USD"))
    .build()
```

### Tip Adjustment
```kotlin
val request = TipAdjustRequest.builder()
    .setTransactionRequestId("TXN_${System.currentTimeMillis()}")
    .setOriginalTransactionId("original_sale_txn_id")
    .setTipAmount(BigDecimal("200"))   // 200 cents = $2.00
    .build()

client.tipAdjust(request, paymentCallback)  // Use with TipMode.AFTER_SALE
```

### Abort
```kotlin
val request = AbortRequest.builder()
    .setOriginalTransactionRequestId("original_txn_request_id")  // ID of in-progress transaction
    .build()

client.abort(request, paymentCallback)  // Only works before gateway authorization
```

### Incremental Authorization
```kotlin
val request = IncrementalAuthRequest.builder()
    .setTransactionRequestId("TXN_${System.currentTimeMillis()}")
    .setOriginalTransactionId("original_auth_txn_id")
    .setAmount(AmountInfo(BigDecimal("5000"), "USD"))  // Additional $50.00
    .build()

client.incrementalAuth(request, paymentCallback)  // Increase pre-auth amount
```

---

## AmountInfo — CRITICAL: Smallest Currency Unit

All amounts are in the **smallest currency unit** (cents for USD/EUR):

```
$10.00 USD → BigDecimal("1000")   ✅
$10.00 USD → BigDecimal("10.00")  ❌ (= $0.10, 100x wrong!)
```

```kotlin
// Constructor style
val amount = AmountInfo(
    orderAmount      = BigDecimal("1000"),   // Required: base order amount before optional tip
    pricingCurrency  = "USD",               // Required, ISO 4217
    tipAmount        = null,                // Optional: keep separate from orderAmount when known upfront
    taxAmount        = null,                // Optional
    surchargeAmount  = null,                // Optional: removed if the card used is Debit Card
    cashbackAmount   = null,                // Optional
    serviceFee       = null                 // Optional
)

// Factory style
val amount = AmountInfo.of(1000L, "USD")           // from Long cents
val amount = AmountInfo.of(BigDecimal("10.00"), "USD")  // auto-converts to cents
```

Keep `orderAmount` as the base order amount only. When tip is known upfront, set `tipAmount` separately so Tapro can calculate and return the final transaction total. If tip is folded into `orderAmount`, tax may also be calculated on the tip portion.

If `surchargeAmount` is present and the customer pays with a **Debit Card**, Tapro removes the surcharge amount before the transaction is completed.

---

## TipConfig — On-Screen Tip

Use `tipConfig` when the terminal should collect tip interactively.
Set it on `SaleRequest`, `AuthRequest`, or `PostAuthRequest` as a top-level field.
`tipConfig` and `amount.tipAmount` are **mutually exclusive**.

```kotlin
val request = SaleRequest.builder()
    .setReferenceOrderId("ORDER001")
    .setTransactionRequestId("TXN001")
    .setAmount(AmountInfo(BigDecimal("1000"), "USD"))
    .setTipConfig(TipConfig(
        useHostConfig = false,           // Use request config (default)
        onScreenTip = true,              // Show tip prompt on terminal
        tipMode = TipMode.ON_SALE,       // Collect during sale
        tipWithTax = false,              // Don't include tax in tip base
        suggestions = TipSuggestions(
            feeMode = FeeMode.RATE,      // Percentages
            values = listOf(15, 18, 20), // 15%, 18%, 20%
            names = null                 // Optional labels
        )
    ))
    .build()
```

**`TipConfig` fields:**

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|-------|------|---------|-------------|
| `useHostConfig` | Boolean | `false` | Whether to use the terminal's tip configuration (true) or the request configuration (false). When `true`, all other fields are ignored and the terminal settings are used as-is. |
| `onScreenTip` | Boolean | `false` | Whether to enable on-screen tip prompt. `true` → show terminal tip screen; `false` → customer writes tip on receipt. |
| `tipMode` | TipMode | `ON_SALE` | When the tip is collected. `ON_SALE` — during sale; `AFTER_SALE` — via `TipAdjust` transaction after sale. |
| `tipWithTax` | Boolean | `false` | Whether tip percentage is calculated on amount including tax. When `true` and `feeMode=RATE`, the tip % applies to total with tax. |
| `suggestions` | TipSuggestions? | `null` | Predefined tip options. When provided, shown as selectable buttons on screen (if `onScreenTip=true`) or printed on receipt (if `onScreenTip=false`). |

**`TipSuggestions` fields:**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `feeMode` | FeeMode | ✅ | How values are interpreted: `RATE` (percentage) or `AMOUNT` (fixed cents). |
| `values` | List<Int> | ✅ | Suggested tip amounts/percentages, e.g., `[15, 18, 20]` for percentages or `[100, 200, 500]` for fixed amounts (cents). |
| `names` | List<String>? | ❌ | Optional labels for each suggestion, e.g., `["Acceptable", "Good", "Great"]`. Position must match `values`. |

---

## Signature Configuration (Sale/Auth only)

*Since v1.0.8,* use `SignatureConfig` to control per-transaction signature capture.
Set it on `SaleRequest`, `AuthRequest`, or `RefundRequest.nonReferencedBuilder()`.

```kotlin
// Always capture on terminal screen
val config = SignatureConfig.onScreen()

// Capture on screen only for amounts > $50.00
val config = SignatureConfig.onScreenAbove(BigDecimal("5000"))

// Always print signature line on receipt
val config = SignatureConfig.onReceipt()

// Print signature line on receipt only for amounts > $50.00
val config = SignatureConfig.onReceiptAbove(BigDecimal("5000"))

// Never collect signature
val config = SignatureConfig.none()

// Use the terminal's configured signature settings (default)
val config = SignatureConfig.useHostConfig()

// Apply to request
val request = SaleRequest.builder()
    .setReferenceOrderId("ORDER_001")
    .setTransactionRequestId("TXN_${System.currentTimeMillis()}")
    .setAmount(AmountInfo.of(15000L, "USD"))  // $150.00
    .setSignatureConfig(SignatureConfig.onScreenAbove(BigDecimal("10000")))  // Require signature only > $100
    .build()
```

| Factory Method | Behavior |
|---|---|
| `useHostConfig()` | Use terminal signature settings (default) |
| `onScreen()` | Always show e-signature page on terminal |
| `onScreenAbove(threshold)` | Show e-signature page only for amounts > threshold |
| `onReceipt()` | Always print signature line on receipt |
| `onReceiptAbove(threshold)` | Print signature line on receipt only for amounts > threshold |
| `none()` | Never collect signature |

---

## PaymentCallback

**CRITICAL:** `onSuccess` means the SDK received a valid response from Tapro—**not** that the payment was approved.
Always check `result.transactionStatus` (via `result.isSuccess()`, `result.isProcessing()`, `result.isFailed()`) inside `onSuccess`.

```kotlin
object : PaymentCallback {
    override fun onProgress(event: PaymentEvent) {
        when (event.eventCode) {
            "WAITING_CARD"      -> showMsg("Present card")
            "WAITING_PIN"       -> showMsg("Enter PIN on terminal")
            "WAITING_SIGNATURE" -> showMsg("Sign on terminal")
            "WAITING_RESPONSE"  -> showMsg("Authorizing...")
            "COMPLETED"         -> hideMsg()
            "CANCEL"            -> showMsg("Cancelled")
        }
    }

    override fun onSuccess(result: PaymentResult) {
        // onSuccess ≠ approved payment — MUST check transactionStatus
        when {
            result.isSuccess()    -> {
                // transactionStatus == "SUCCESS" → Approved, safe to fulfill order
                confirmPayment(result)
            }
            result.isProcessing() -> {
                // transactionStatus == "PROCESSING" → Gateway still deciding, poll for status
                pollStatus(result.transactionRequestId!!)
            }
            result.isFailed()     -> {
                // transactionStatus == "FAILED" → Declined, do NOT fulfill order
                showDeclined(result.message)
            }
        }
    }

    override fun onFailure(error: PaymentError) {
        when (error.code) {
            "306"  -> pollStatus(error.transactionRequestId!!)  // Timeout: query first
            "308"  -> showError("Duplicate ID, create new transaction")
            else   -> if (error.canRetryWithSameId) retry() else showError(error.message)
        }
    }
}
```

---

## Error Handling

### Error Categories
| Category | Cause | Action |
|----------|-------|--------|
| `INITIALIZATION` | SDK not initialized | Re-call `TaplinkSDK.init()` |
| `CONNECTION` | Connection failed/lost | Check mode, re-call `TaplinkSDK.connect()` |
| `AUTHENTICATION` | Wrong credentials | Verify `TaplinkConfig` fields |
| `TRANSACTION` | Transaction error | Check `error.code` and `canRetryWithSameId` |

### Transaction Error Codes
| Code | Issue | Retry |
|------|-------|-------|
| 301–305 | SDK/network errors | ✅ Same ID |
| 306 | Timeout | ⚠️ Query first |
| 307–311 | Transaction rejected/duplicate/failed | ❌ New ID |

### Error 306 — Timeout Pattern (MANDATORY)

> **UI Note:** Query runs entirely in the background — Tapro will NOT show any UI or loading screen.
> You MUST implement your own loading/waiting indicator while the query is in progress.
> Show a spinner or "Querying transaction status..." message between calling `client.query()` and receiving the callback.

```kotlin
override fun onFailure(error: PaymentError) {
    if (error.code == "306") {
        showLoading("Querying transaction status...")  // Your own loading UI
        pollStatus(error.transactionRequestId!!)  // MUST query before any retry
    }
}

fun pollStatus(txnRequestId: String, attempt: Int = 1) {
    if (attempt > 12) { showError("Unknown status, contact support"); return }
    client.query(QueryRequest().setTransactionRequestId(txnRequestId), object : PaymentCallback {
        override fun onSuccess(result: PaymentResult) {
            when (result.transactionStatus) {
                "SUCCESS"    -> handleSuccess(result)
                "FAILED"     -> handleFailure(result)
                "PROCESSING" -> Handler(Looper.getMainLooper()).postDelayed(
                    { pollStatus(txnRequestId, attempt + 1) }, 5000
                )
            }
        }
        override fun onFailure(error: PaymentError) {
            Handler(Looper.getMainLooper()).postDelayed({ pollStatus(txnRequestId, attempt + 1) }, 5000)
        }
        override fun onProgress(event: PaymentEvent) {}
    })
}
```

---

## Key Rules (Never Violate)

1. **onSuccess ≠ payment approved**: `onSuccess` means SDK received valid Tapro response. **ALWAYS check `result.isSuccess()`** before fulfilling order. Declined/processing results also trigger `onSuccess`. Cancelled/aborted transactions arrive as `isFailed()`.
2. **onFailure = communication error only**: `onFailure` fires **only** for SDK/network errors (connection lost, timeout, bad config). Card declines and cancellations NEVER arrive in `onFailure`.
2. **Amount unit**: Always use smallest currency unit (cents). `$10.00 = BigDecimal("1000")`
3. **transactionRequestId**: Must be globally unique per request. Never reuse after errors 307/308/309/310/311.
4. **Error 306**: Always query status before retrying. Never create a new transaction blindly.
5. **lib_taplink_communication**: Never import directly. Only use `lib_taplink_sdk`.
6. **Callbacks on background thread**: Always `runOnUiThread {}` for UI updates in callbacks.
7. **Query has no Tapro UI**: `client.query()` runs in background — you MUST show your own loading indicator while waiting for the callback.
7. **Cleanup**: Always call `disconnect()` + `removeConnectionListener()` in `onDestroy()`.
8. **tipConfig vs tipAmount**: Mutually exclusive. Set one or neither, never both.
9. **tipAmount placement**: Keep tip out of `orderAmount` and set `tipAmount` separately when known upfront, or tax may also be applied to the tip portion.
10. **Debit surcharge handling**: If `surchargeAmount` is sent and the card used is a Debit Card, Tapro removes the surcharge amount before completion.
11. **Abort prerequisites**: Abort only works before gateway authorization (during card detection/PIN entry stages). For authorized transactions, use Void (same-day) or Refund (cross-day).
12. **INIT is automatic**: Do not call INIT manually. It runs on the first transaction after connect.
13. **signatureConfig**: Use factory methods (`onScreen()`, `onReceipt()`, `onScreenAbove()`, `none()`, `useHostConfig()`) to configure per-transaction signature behavior. Can be combined with Sale, Auth, and non-referenced Refund.

---

## Java Interop Adapters

For Java projects, use adapter classes instead of interfaces:

```java
// Instead of implementing ConnectionListener interface:
TaplinkSDK.connect(config, new ConnectionListenerAdapter() {
    @Override public void onConnected(String deviceId, String taproVersion) { ... }
    // onDisconnected and onError have empty defaults
});

// Instead of implementing PaymentCallback interface:
client.sale(request, new PaymentCallbackAdapter() {
    @Override public void onSuccess(PaymentResult result) { ... }
    @Override public void onFailure(PaymentError error) { ... }
    // onProgress and onDeclined have empty defaults
});
```

---

## PaymentResult Key Fields

```
result.code                // "0" = success
result.transactionStatus   // "SUCCESS" | "PROCESSING" | "FAILED"
result.transactionId       // SUNBAY platform ID — use for void/refund/postAuth
result.referenceOrderId    // Echoed from request
result.amount              // TransactionAmount (total, tip, tax breakdown)
result.cardInfo            // Card type, last 4 digits, input method
result.authCode            // Bank authorization code
result.rrn                 // Retrieval Reference Number
result.stan                // System Trace Audit Number
result.receiptJson         // Receipt data as JSON
result.isSuccess()         // code=="0" && transactionStatus=="SUCCESS"
result.isProcessing()      // transactionStatus=="PROCESSING"
result.isFailed()          // transactionStatus=="FAILED" || code!="0"
```

## Go-Live Checklist

- [ ] `logEnabled = false` in production
- [ ] All amounts in smallest currency unit
- [ ] `transactionRequestId` is unique per transaction (use UUID)
- [ ] Error 306: query-first logic implemented
- [ ] Query UI: loading indicator shown while `client.query()` is in progress (Tapro shows no UI)
- [ ] Error 307/308: new ID logic implemented
- [ ] `disconnect()` + `removeConnectionListener()` in `onDestroy()`
- [ ] USB permission handling for Cable mode
- [ ] Tested disconnect/reconnect cycle
